grades.quote: If no data is available, a read on a pipe waits for either data to be written or for all file descriptors referring to the write end to be closed; in the latter case, read will return 0, just as if the end of a data file had been reached.
grades.reason: Directly explains the failure: EOF requires closing every write-end descriptor, not merely terminating one child.
Explains child termination, waiting, and zombies, but not pipe EOF or write-end ownership.
Only proposes a pipe performance exercise; provides no EOF diagnosis.
